interpretation.null_increment: strict gate rate is the empirical false-positive rate for a non-incremental spatial representation
interpretation.spatial_increment: strict gate rate is empirical power for a zero-mean coordinate-specific signal beyond pseudobulk expression
interpretation.source_overlap: random-cell AUROC is an invalid-estimand diagnostic because test cells have sources represented in training
interpretation.mismatched_reference: candidate and matched expression contain the same information; any weak-reference gain is manufactured by the comparator
